title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file
description: patch_file failed twice on .github/workflows/release.yml when attempting to update actions/cache@v4. Both hunks had correct context but the removed lines were not matched. The operation was recovered via write_file. This is occurrence 4 of this signal.
proposed_resolution: Fix patch_file.rs to correctly handle context relocation; update run.skill.md to fall back to write_file after a single patch_file failure.

title: github_releases tool not exposed in MCP session despite being implemented
description: github_releases is implemented and registered in src/moeb but was absent from the Claude Code MCP session's deferred tool schema. WebFetch was used as a fallback, causing moeb-tool-origin to fail.
proposed_resolution: Restart the Claude Code MCP extension with the latest compiled moeb binary so that github_releases appears in the MCP tool schema.

title: run.skill.md should use write_file after patch_file failure
description: Two failed patch_file attempts preceded write_file escalation. An explicit 'fail once, escalate' rule would reduce tool_errors per run.
proposed_resolution: Add to run.skill.md Phase 3: after a single patch_file failure on a file, fall back immediately to write_file.

title: Missing moeb tool: github_releases (not exposed in MCP session)
description: Used WebFetch to replicate github_releases API logic because the tool was not available in the MCP tool schema for this session.
proposed_resolution: Restart the Claude Code MCP extension with the latest compiled moeb binary. No new moeb tool is needed.
